taskResults.notes: REVISITED after operator re-approval of the AC-1 as-built amendment (2026-09-27): T2's independent review proved the PATHEXT-first first-match order regressed the default claude bin vs pre-319 libuv spawn (PATHEXT=.CMD -> not-found; earlier non-canonical claude.cmd shadowing claude.exe -> spawn-error). Resolver now native-first two-pass (.com/.exe across PATH, then .bat/.cmd by PATH x PATHEXT). Independent re-review PASS with real-machine spawnSync parity for claude/node/git/gh; orchestrator re-verified 54/54 resolver tests + real-machine probe of both regression scenarios; ENOENT wording updated for the two-pass order.

makeRealSpawn factory wires the win32 resolver into the real spawn seam (piped stdio, no shell key; family/guard/error text keyed on configured bin). Independent Opus review round 1 proved a default-claude regression in T1's search order (fixed via operator-approved AC-1 amendment + T1 revisit) and a vacuous cwd test; round 2 PASS. Orchestrator re-verified: host-cli-client + win32-command + host-cli-verifier 106/106, test diff deletions confined to T2-added code, win32 real-process test ran (not skipped).

docs/providers.md Windows resolution paragraphs (native-first two-pass, cwd never searched, npm cmd-shim via Node without shell, non-npm launchers refused, native-exe override), stale stdin text + argv prompt examples corrected; doc test providers-host-cli-windows.test.ts (319-01/AC-6); patch changeset. Orchestrator re-read the doc diff and corrected three inaccuracies (old spawn was not shell-mediated; CVE sentence; changeset 'silently'/'the way a shell would'); all 41 doc test files pass. Independent review of T3 is folded into the whole-branch review, which re-reads docs last.

AC-1.reason: Two-pass native-first resolver uses case-insensitive PATH/PATHEXT, win32 joins, and skips non-qualified segments; linked resolver/seam tests cover .exe, PATHEXT and cwd cases.

AC-2.reason: Resolver probes recognized suffixes as-is and parses canonical npm/legacy shims to Node+JS or native .exe; linked resolver and seam tests verify command, args, stdio and no shell.

AC-3.reason: Unsafe/unrecognized shim shapes throw plain errors naming bin and CADENCE_HOST_CLI_BIN before underlying spawn; seam and resolver tests cover noncanonical and escape refusals.

AC-4.reason: Resolution stays inside real spawn; family derives from configured bin, cwd/relative PATH entries are excluded, and ENOENT maps to not-found before spawn. Linked tests exercise each.

AC-5.reason: Non-win32 returns {command: bin, prefixArgs: []} before filesystem access; linked Linux test and Darwin tests verify no probing.

AC-6.reason: Host-cli docs describe Windows two-pass PATH behavior, no cwd/shell, refusal and native override; examples use stdin and text says it is closed. Linked docs tests exercise this.
